arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as failed_job_count FROM failed_jobs;

arguments.summary: The failed-jobs backlog has been growing all week, with 1204 failed jobs as of 12 minutes ago. The pgbouncer service is degraded with 100 connections in use and no worker throughput. Queries on the read replica and primary show the current failed-job counts. Restarting pgbouncer is recommended to potentially alleviate the connection pool issues.
arguments.recommended_next_step: Restart pgbouncer and monitor the connection pool status. Once the connection pool is back to normal, investigate the root cause of the failed jobs and address it to prevent future failures.
